name: slice-bootstrap
description: Expand a CivicAction issue into a complete, reviewable slice specification without changing its approved goal or scope.
---

# Slice bootstrap

Use the supplied issue number to read the issue, its parent epic, actual dependency issues, [the slice contract](../../../docs/022-slice-contract.md), relevant project documents, and accepted ADRs. Read [the role contract](../../../docs/ai/roles/slice-bootstrap.md) and [the slice template](../../../docs/slices/TEMPLATE.md) before preparing the result.

Expand the issue specification with a clear goal, bounded scope, exclusions, testable acceptance criteria, dependencies and why they block, security/privacy review needs, validation strategy, and expected evidence or artifacts. Identify contradictions, assumptions, and unknowns; flag anything requiring owner input. Keep the issue's stated scope intact.

Do not implement the issue. Generated detail supplements, and does not replace review of, the slice contract.
